summary.text:
# 一个崭新的联邦 / A New Federation

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/federations_events_1.txt:2738-2866

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 加入联邦时（on_join_federation，00_on_actions.txt:3506）运行隐藏的 fedev.499：联邦至少有2名成员且其中有非AI国家（起源不是共同点/霸主），然后发出 fedev.500。
  On joining a federation (on_join_federation, 00_on_actions.txt:3506) hidden fedev.499 runs: the federation needs two members including a non-AI one (origin not Common Ground / Hegemon), then fires fedev.500.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「新联邦」：每个帝国一次（first_federation_event）；断镣起源若联邦中有奴隶主则不出现；单选项给50点完整性（integrity）。
  "A New Federation": once per empire (first_federation_event); not shown to Broken Shackles when the federation has slavers; one option gives 50 integrity.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
